newsitem.title: USA: US Natl Assoc of Home Builders July survey delayed.
newsitem.headline: US Natl Assoc of Home Builders July survey delayed.

text.p: The National Association of Home Builders (NAHB) index of early July housing activity will be delayed from Wednesday to Thursday because of a bulk-mail problem, NAHB said.
The monthly index stood at 57.0 in June.

The NAHB said it has had difficulty receiving responses to its monthly survey, which is sent out at the end of each month. Responses are usually received within the first 10 days of the month. The data are analyzed and the index is released the day before U.S. housing starts figures.
This month's delay was being attributed to problems with the mail, NAHB said. It was the first time NAHB had experienced this type of delay.
NAHB said it had not yet determined whether the survey would be released at the regular 1200 EDT/1600 GMT time on Thursday. No further details were immediately available.
